articles.title: How a heated argument turned fatal for Kolkata techie; partner, her mom arrested

articles.title: MPSC Group C Recruitment 2026: Vacancies increased to 16,717, application window reopens on November 13
articles.summary: MPSC Group C Recruitment 2026: The Maharashtra Public Service Commission has increased Group C recruitment vacancies from 5,707 to 16,717, adding 11,010 posts across government departments. The online application window will reopen from November 13 to November 27, 2026.

articles.title: The ‘king’ who helped bring Rome to Britain in AD 43 may have been a woman; archaeologist challenges a 2,000-year-old assumption
articles.summary: Archaeologist Miles Russell has proposed that Verica, the Iron Age ruler whose appeal to Roman Emperor Claudius may have helped trigger Rome's invasion of Britain in AD 43, could have been a woman. His theory draws on the ruler's name, coin imagery and inscriptions, alongside evidence of women's social status in Iron Age Britain.

articles.title: 'Ramayana:' day 4: Ranbir, Sai, Yash's film approaches Rs 500 cr worldwide
articles.summary: Nitesh Tiwari's 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend' has grossed nearly Rs 500 cr worldwide within four days. The film, featuring key performances from Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi, crossed Rs 200 cr in India net collections.

articles.title: Anirudh-Kavya wedding: Rajinikanth, MK Stalin, Udhayanidhi head to Greece
articles.summary: Anirudh Ravichander and Kavya Maran are gearing up for their wedding in the picturesque landscape of Greece, igniting excitement in both their families and fans alike. Esteemed personalities such as Rajinikanth and MK Stalin are anticipated guests.

articles.title: Adnan Sami slams airport service: Singer alleges rude staff
articles.summary: Singer Adnan Sami has slammed Pranaam Services at Mumbai Airport’s T2 after a five-hour Air India delay. He alleged no one received his team, they were told of the delay late, and a staff member was rude and glued to her phone.

articles.title: Krishnasamy warns Kamal Haasan against using the 'Sandiyar' title
articles.summary: Kamal Haasan's new film 'Sandiyar' is stirring controversy over possible caste-related violence. Krishnasamy, president of the New Tamilagam Party, has raised serious objections to the title, threatening legal action if it remains unchanged.
